name: gi-bookkeeping-and-tax-records
description: Gibraltar bookkeeping and tax-record preservation reference for persons required to file income tax returns, with separate company-law record duties. Covers day-to-day cash records, stocktaking, transaction evidence, English-language books, six-year retention and enquiry extensions. Includes a period-end retention example and reconciliation workflow, distinguishing practical controls from statutory requirements. Based on the Income Tax Act consolidation dated March 2026 and Companies Act consolidation dated August 2025. Independent review is pending; specialised tax, payroll, regulated-sector and electronic-record rules remain separate.
